about: A research run: `mark` closes r1 and r2 with their link lines, the Edit guard finds nothing in flags-1, and `act` runs on it: 'acted', nothing awaited. The session stops before `close`. recover runs once (nothing to redo). `abandon` at 17:00: `act` ran on the check of mark's link lines and closes, so Never checked doesn't list them; with nothing else unchecked, the section is left out. Other notes names the snapshot folder. The requests stay closed and linked.
readings: Never checked is empty here, so the case checks it is absent; that also proves no link line or close is listed in it.
The stuck state is reached by stopping before `close` after a recover, as in case 231; Runs/ read-only on `close` was not used.
